name: mroosz/php-cassandra
description: A pure-PHP client for Apache Cassandra and ScyllaDB with support for CQL binary protocol v3, v4 and v5 (Cassandra 2.1+ incl. 3.x-5.x; ScyllaDB 6.2, 2025.x, 2026.x), synchronous and asynchronous APIs, prepared statements, batches, result iterators, object mapping, SSL/TLS, and LZ4 compression.

suggest.ext-bcmath: Faster large-integer math for the Varint and Decimal types, used when gmp is not present; a pure-PHP calculator is the fallback
suggest.ext-gmp: Faster large-integer math for the Varint and Decimal types, preferred over bcmath when both are present; a pure-PHP calculator is the fallback
suggest.ext-lz4: Native LZ4 (de)compression, used automatically when present for much faster compressed connections; a pure-PHP implementation is the transparent fallback
suggest.ext-openssl: TLS/SSL encrypted connections, required for tls:// connections configured with StreamNodeConfig
suggest.ext-sockets: Socket transport, required for connections configured with SocketNodeConfig; StreamNodeConfig connections need no extension
